title: Concept: Requirement that pulls a non-runtime extra
description: requirements.txt declares an extra that installs development or test dependencies at runtime, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A name or scope that resolves outside the project's intended registry is fetched from a source nobody reviewed, so a publish there becomes an install here. This rule reads an extra that installs development or test dependencies at runtime.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through requirements.txt (pypi).
risk: A name or scope that resolves outside the project's intended registry is fetched from a source nobody reviewed, so a publish there becomes an install here. This rule reads an extra that installs development or test dependencies at runtime.
